Testing task complete. 169 tests across 3 packages, all passing.

## Summary

### packages/data_sources (106 tests)
**M3U Parser** (34 tests) - `test/m3u_parser_test.dart`
- Standard EXTINF parsing, url-tvg header, catchup attributes
- EXTVLCOPT directives (user-agent, referrer, http-origin, multiple)
- EXTGRP override behavior, single-quoted attributes
- UTF-8/Latin-1 encoding detection via parseBytes
- Builder validation (reset, missing fields, throws)
- Content type inference (live, vod, series by URL pattern)
- Edge cases: empty file, header-only, deduplication, unknown directives
- Large playlist isolate path (600 entries)
- toString, effectiveName fallback

**Xtream API Client** (41 tests) - `test/xtream_api_client_test.dart`
- Auth: success, failure, Active status fallback
- Content: getLiveCategories, getLiveStreams, getVodCategories, getSeriesCategories, getVodStreams
- EPG: getShortEpg, getFullEpg
- URL building: live/vod/series/unknown types, trailing slash normalization
- VOD metadata: year from explicit field, year extracted from name, rating, containerExtension
- Caching: categories cached on second call, clearCache invalidates, serverInfo cached
- Error types: XtreamAuthError, NetworkError, ServerError, TimeoutError, sealed exhaustiveness
- Error mapping: non-list responses throw XtreamServerError

**Stalker Portal Client** (17 tests) - `test/stalker_portal_client_test.dart`
- Handshake with SHA1 prehash, empty token error
- getProfile with auth_second_step and metrics, nested account_info parsing
- All content types: getLiveCategories, getLiveChannels, getVodCategories, getVodList, getSeriesCategories, getSeriesList
- EPG: getEpg with timestamp parsing
- createLink: ffrt prefix stripping, ffmpeg prefix stripping, empty URL error
- Pagination: page parameter propagation, optional categoryId
- Models: StalkerAuthToken expiry, fromJson, StalkerCategory, StalkerChannel, StalkerEpgEntry (including null timestamps), StalkerServerInfo (flat and nested)
- Error types: sealed exhaustiveness

**XMLTV Parser** (14 tests) - `test/xmltv/xmltv_parser_test.dart`
- Channel/programme parsing, timezone offset conversion
- Missing fields, empty content, orphan programmes, CDATA sections
- Gzip URL detection
- EpgParseResult, EpgProgramme duration/isNow/progress/timeRemaining

### packages/local_db (41 tests)
**XtreamRepository** (26 tests) - `test/xtream_repository_test.dart`
- Source CRUD: add, get, getAll, update, delete (cascading), updateLastSyncAt
- Categories: sync, sort, filter by type, favorites
- Streams: sync, filter by categoryId, search query, favorites (set/toggle/move), sorting (nameAsc, nameDesc)
- fullSync: data replacement, channel favorite preservation, category favorite preservation, lastSyncAt update, all content types
- M3U: addM3uSource with type=m3u, syncM3uSource groups+channels

**WatchHistoryRepository** (15 tests) - `test/watch_history_repository_test.dart`
- addEntry: insert, upsert same channel
- getRecent: ordering by watchedAt desc, limit
- getForChannel: found, not found
- getResumePosition: in-progress returns position, 0 returns null, >95% returns null, exactly 95% returns position, duration=0 (live), unknown channel
- clearAll, deleteOlderThan (with old entries, without)

### packages/ui_tv (22 tests)
**ToastOverlay** (14 tests) - `test/toast_overlay_test.dart`
- ToastNotifier: initial empty, show, multiple stacking, dismiss, non-existent dismiss, auto-dismiss after 3s, unique IDs
- ToastMessage: creation, unique IDs
- Widget: renders child, displays toast via provider, multiple toasts stack, auto-dismiss after timeout, dismiss button

**TVStreamCard** (8 tests) - `test/tv_stream_card_test.dart`
- Renders channel name, LIVE badge, MOVIE badge
- Favorite icon shown/hidden, tap callback fires
- showTitle=false hides name, play indicator on focus
